desc: Prove that greedily absorbing any currently eligible adjacent slime cannot reduce the eventual maximum obtainable strength.
Define the frontier expansion invariant: every unvisited cell adjacent to Takahashi’s current region is represented in the priority queue.
Implement a min-heap traversal starting from `(P-1, Q-1)`, with a visited grid to ensure every cell is pushed at most once.
Use the strict eligibility condition `value * X < strength`, avoiding floating-point division and precision issues.
Verify complexity is `O(HW log(HW))` time and `O(HW)` memory, suitable for a `500 × 500` grid.
